snippet.title: Code Vein - Frozen Empress DLC - PS4/XB1/PC
snippet.description:
Hell froze over, and it took on the form of a deadly new foe. 
Explore The Celestial Ice Prison and face the Frozen Empress in Code Vein’s second DLC, now available!
